title: Oven Roasted German Squash Casserole
description: A light German dish featuring roasted squash, poached in a fermented sauce, suitable for an ayurvedic tamasic diet. This casserole is a perfect blend of flavors and textures.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the cubed squash with olive oil, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the squash mixture on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 30 minutes, or until tender.
While the squash is roasting, toast the caraway seeds in a small pan over medium heat for 2 minutes, or until fragrant.
In a separate pan, poach the eggs and slice them into wedges.
In a large casserole dish, create a layer of sauerkraut, followed by a layer of roasted squash, and then a layer of poached eggs.
Sprinkle the toasted caraway seeds and shredded cheese over the top layer of the casserole.
Bake the casserole in the oven for 15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
